// Package migrations applies the repository-owned Student PostgreSQL schema.
package migrations

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

const (
	historyTable      = "student_schema_migrations"
	migrationLockName = "ms-go-student-migrations-v1"
	migrationLockWait = 5 * time.Second
)

var (
	outerBegin  = regexp.MustCompile(`(?is)\A(?:\s|--[^\r\n]*(?:\r?\n|\z)|/\*.*?\*/)*BEGIN\s*;`)
	outerCommit = regexp.MustCompile(`(?is)COMMIT\s*;(?:\s|--[^\r\n]*(?:\r?\n|\z)|/\*.*?\*/)*\z`)
)

// Migration is one forward-only SQL file from db/migrations.
type Migration struct {
	Filename string
	SQL      string
	SHA256   string
}

// Status is schema metadata only. It never includes application rows.
type Status struct {
	Database           string
	Role               string
	Superuser          bool
	PublicTableCount   int
	HistoryTableExists bool
	Applied            int
	Available          int
}

// Runner applies the same SQL source for native, Docker, and CI invocations.
type Runner struct {
	pool       *pgxpool.Pool
	migrations []Migration
}

// New opens the configured PostgreSQL database and reads the supplied SQL files.
func New(ctx context.Context, databaseURL, directory string) (*Runner, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(databaseURL) == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("DATABASE_URL is required")
	}
	migrationList, err := Discover(directory)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, databaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("connect PostgreSQL: %w", err)
	}
	if err := pool.Ping(ctx); err != nil {
		pool.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("ping PostgreSQL: %w", err)
	}
	return &Runner{pool: pool, migrations: migrationList}, nil
}

// Close releases the PostgreSQL connection pool.
func (runner *Runner) Close() {
	if runner != nil && runner.pool != nil {
		runner.pool.Close()
	}
}

// Discover reads and sorts the repository-owned forward SQL files.
func Discover(directory string) ([]Migration, error) {
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(directory)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read migration directory: %w", err)
	}
	migrations := make([]Migration, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if entry.IsDir() || filepath.Ext(entry.Name()) != ".sql" || strings.HasSuffix(strings.ToLower(entry.Name()), ".down.sql") {
			continue
		}
		contents, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(directory, entry.Name()))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read migration %s: %w", entry.Name(), err)
		}
		if len(strings.TrimSpace(string(contents))) == 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("migration %s is empty", entry.Name())
		}
		digest := sha256.Sum256(contents)
		migrations = append(migrations, Migration{
			Filename: entry.Name(),
			SQL:      string(contents),
			SHA256:   fmt.Sprintf("%x", digest),
		})
	}
	if len(migrations) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no SQL migrations found in %s", directory)
	}
	sort.Slice(migrations, func(i, j int) bool {
		return migrations[i].Filename < migrations[j].Filename
	})
	return migrations, nil
}

// Status reports connection identity, migration ledger state, and schema size.
func (runner *Runner) Status(ctx context.Context) (Status, error) {
	return statusOn(ctx, runner.pool, len(runner.migrations))
}

type queryRower interface {
	QueryRow(context.Context, string, ...any) pgx.Row
}

func statusOn(ctx context.Context, connection queryRower, available int) (Status, error) {
	status := Status{Available: available}
	if err := connection.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT current_database(), current_user,
       (SELECT rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user)
`).Scan(&status.Database, &status.Role, &status.Superuser); err != nil {
		return Status{}, fmt.Errorf("read database identity: %w", err)
	}
	if err := connection.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT to_regclass('public.student_schema_migrations') IS NOT NULL`).Scan(&status.HistoryTableExists); err != nil {
		return Status{}, fmt.Errorf("check migration ledger: %w", err)
	}
	if err := connection.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT count(*)
FROM pg_tables
WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND tablename <> $1
`, historyTable).Scan(&status.PublicTableCount); err != nil {
		return Status{}, fmt.Errorf("count public tables: %w", err)
	}
	if status.HistoryTableExists {
		if err := connection.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM student_schema_migrations`).Scan(&status.Applied); err != nil {
			return Status{}, fmt.Errorf("count applied migrations: %w", err)
		}
	}
	return status, nil
}

// Up applies pending migrations in lexical filename order. A single physical
// PostgreSQL connection owns the session lock and every state read and write
// until the lock is released.
func (runner *Runner) Up(ctx context.Context) (completed []string, resultErr error) {
	connection, err := runner.pool.Acquire(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("acquire migration connection: %w", err)
	}
	defer connection.Release()

	if _, err := connection.Exec(ctx, `SELECT pg_advisory_lock(hashtext($1))`, migrationLockName); err != nil {
		// If the request was canceled after PostgreSQL granted the lock, the
		// outcome is ambiguous. Discard this session instead of pooling a lock.
		_ = connection.Conn().PgConn().Close(context.Background())
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lock migrations: %w", err)
	}
	defer func() {
		unlockCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), migrationLockWait)
		defer cancel()
		var unlocked bool
		if err := connection.QueryRow(unlockCtx, `SELECT pg_advisory_unlock(hashtext($1))`, migrationLockName).Scan(&unlocked); err != nil || !unlocked {
			// Never return a session with an unknown lock state to the pool.
			_ = connection.Conn().PgConn().Close(context.Background())
			if resultErr == nil {
				if err != nil {
					resultErr = fmt.Errorf("unlock migrations: %w", err)
				} else {
					resultErr = errors.New("unlock migrations: session advisory lock was not held")
				}
			}
		}
	}()

	status, err := statusOn(ctx, connection, len(runner.migrations))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !status.HistoryTableExists && status.PublicTableCount > 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("refusing to adopt an existing Student schema without a migration ledger")
	}
	if status.HistoryTableExists && status.Applied == 0 && status.PublicTableCount > 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("migration ledger is empty while the Student schema contains tables; inspect and recover explicitly")
	}

	applied := make(map[string]string)
	if status.HistoryTableExists {
		applied, err = readHistory(ctx, connection)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	if err := validateHistory(runner.migrations, applied); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	completed = make([]string, 0)
	historyExists := status.HistoryTableExists
	for _, migration := range runner.migrations {
		if _, exists := applied[migration.Filename]; exists {
			continue
		}
		if err := runner.applyOne(ctx, connection, migration, !historyExists); err != nil {
			return completed, fmt.Errorf("apply %s: %w", migration.Filename, err)
		}
		historyExists = true
		applied[migration.Filename] = migration.SHA256
		completed = append(completed, migration.Filename)
	}
	return completed, nil
}

func readHistory(ctx context.Context, connection *pgxpool.Conn) (map[string]string, error) {
	rows, err := connection.Query(ctx, `SELECT filename, sha256 FROM student_schema_migrations ORDER BY filename`)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read migration ledger: %w", err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	applied := make(map[string]string)
	for rows.Next() {
		var filename, digest string
		if err := rows.Scan(&filename, &digest); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("scan migration ledger: %w", err)
		}
		applied[filename] = strings.TrimSpace(digest)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("iterate migration ledger: %w", err)
	}
	return applied, nil
}

func validateHistory(migrations []Migration, applied map[string]string) error {
	known := make(map[string]string, len(migrations))
	for _, migration := range migrations {
		known[migration.Filename] = migration.SHA256
	}
	for filename, digest := range applied {
		expected, knownMigration := known[filename]
		if !knownMigration {
			return fmt.Errorf("migration ledger contains unknown migration %s", filename)
		}
		if digest != expected {
			return fmt.Errorf("migration %s checksum differs from the repository source", filename)
		}
	}
	for index, migration := range migrations {
		_, isApplied := applied[migration.Filename]
		if isApplied {
			continue
		}
		for _, later := range migrations[index+1:] {
			if _, laterApplied := applied[later.Filename]; laterApplied {
				return fmt.Errorf("migration ledger has a gap before %s", later.Filename)
			}
		}
		break
	}
	return nil
}

func (runner *Runner) applyOne(ctx context.Context, connection *pgxpool.Conn, migration Migration, createHistory bool) error {
	sql, err := normalizeOuterTransaction(migration.SQL)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	tx, err := connection.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(context.Background()) }()

	if createHistory {
		if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
CREATE TABLE student_schema_migrations (
    filename text PRIMARY KEY,
    sha256 char(64) NOT NULL,
    applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
`); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("create migration ledger: %w", err)
		}
	}
	if _, err := tx.Conn().PgConn().Exec(ctx, sql).ReadAll(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO student_schema_migrations (filename, sha256) VALUES ($1, $2)`, migration.Filename, migration.SHA256); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("record migration checksum: %w", err)
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

// normalizeOuterTransaction removes a migration's optional outer BEGIN/COMMIT
// pair so its SQL and checksum can share the runner-owned transaction.
func normalizeOuterTransaction(sql string) (string, error) {
	begin := outerBegin.FindStringIndex(sql)
	commit := outerCommit.FindStringIndex(sql)
	if (begin == nil) != (commit == nil) {
		return "", errors.New("migration has an incomplete outer BEGIN/COMMIT pair")
	}
	if begin == nil {
		return strings.TrimSpace(sql), nil
	}
	if begin[1] > commit[0] {
		return "", errors.New("migration outer transaction has no SQL body")
	}
	body := strings.TrimSpace(sql[begin[1]:commit[0]])
	if body == "" {
		return "", errors.New("migration outer transaction has no SQL body")
	}
	return body, nil
}

// PrintStatus writes only non-sensitive database metadata for operators.
func PrintStatus(status Status) string {
	history := "absent"
	if status.HistoryTableExists {
		history = "present"
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf(
		"database=%s role=%s superuser=%t public_tables=%d migration_ledger=%s migrations=%d/%d checked_at=%s",
		status.Database,
		status.Role,
		status.Superuser,
		status.PublicTableCount,
		history,
		status.Applied,
		status.Available,
		time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),
	)
}
